title: Fastify #4021: crash when using async handler send stream

error_signal.message: fastify UnhandledPromiseRejection: crash when async route handler sends a stream via reply.send(stream)

ground_truth.root_cause_description: wrapThenable does not properly handle the case where an async handler returns after already sending a stream response, causing an unhandled promise rejection.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add proper error handling in wrapThenable for stream responses from async handlers
